title: Invocation entropy & cold-start attribution curated mart for tenant-level analytics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a curated, denormalized mart that surfaces tenant-level invocation entropy and cold-start (first-request-after-idle) attribution for Console usage analytics. This mart will power tenant health dashboards, SLA investigations, and automated cost optimization recommendations in Redwood Console. It should be optimized for fast slices by tenant_id, route_id, model_variant, and hour/day partitions.
background_and_rationale: Current console usage tables focus on aggregate token and route counts but lack a first-class signal for invocation entropy (variance in route patterns and model choices) and cold-start behavior that correlates with latency/cost spikes. By materializing these signals we can: (1) surface tenants with unstable invocation patterns, (2) attribute cold-start induced latency/cost to specific model variants or deployment pools, and (3) enable automated suggested policies (prefetch, warm pools, or routing changes).
modeling_decisions: Sessionization: 5 minute inactivity window to form sessions; configurable per-tenant in downstream transforms
Entropy metric: compute per-tenant Shannon entropy across route_id and model_variant over sliding 7-day and 30-day windows

Cold-start detection: mark invocation as cold-start if no prior invocation from same tenant x route x model_variant in preceding 30 minutes OR if deployment pool reported scale-up within prior 1 minute
SCD handling: model_variant metadata to be SCD2 (effective_from,effective_to) to preserve historical attribution
Partitioning: partition mart on tenant_id and date(hour) with clustering on route_id, model_variant
Storage format: Delta Lake tables with Z-order on tenant_id + date for query performance
Backfill policy: incremental backfill using job that replays callstream with idempotent upserts keyed by invocation_id
acceptance_criteria: API query: dashboards can return top 20 tenants by 7-day entropy in < 6s for production cluster
Cold-start attribution: at least 90% precision against golden sample instrumented with runtime traces
Storage: weekly incremental delta size < 15% of full snapshot when using partitioning and Z-order
QA: automated data checks (row counts, null rates, entropy bounds) run in CI and pass for sample tenants
Documentation: model definition and example SQL queries checked into Console analytics handbook
work_notes: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: aligned with Console metrics and Runtime SRE. Decided on 5-minute session window; PM requested exploring 1-minute for high-frequency tenants.
2026-03-04 - Prototype: computed entropy in adhoc notebook for 50 tenants; observed long-tail where 2% tenants account for 78% entropy variance.
2026-03-06 - Design review: agreed on Delta Lake + Z-order and SCD2 for model metadata. Data infra recommends daily materialized snapshot with hourly micro-partitions.
2026-03-09 - Blocker: discovered inconsistent request_id deduping across callstream shards; engineering assigned ENG-51234 as upstream fix. Interim mitigation added dedupe by (invocation_id) in ETL.
2026-03-11 - Perf tests: initial ETL run for 30 days of data completed in 2.2 hours. Querying top tenants by entropy executed in 4.7s on prod-analytics cluster.

2026-03-12 - Security/PII check: payload-level identifiers removed; only tenant_id and hashed route fingerprints stored in mart. Security review not required but SRE asked to document retention policy.

GH#315 - Delta table creation and Z-order clustering

storage_estimate: ~420GB raw events -> ~18GB curated delta per month (after partitioning & dedupe)
migration_steps: Create staging delta table and run idempotent ETL for 60 days for verification
Run reconciliation queries against existing route-usage aggregates to validate counts
Enable nightly incremental job for production, keep snapshot history for 90 days
Deprecate old adhoc entropy views after 2 weeks of stable production runs
test_plan: Unit tests for entropy function with synthetic distributions
Integration test that marks cold-start when capacity_event indicates scale-up
Smoke test that queries top-10 tenants and validates non-empty results
Regression test to assert no PII is present in output columns
rollout_plan: Week 1: run in staging and validate metrics with SIG owners. Week 2: soft launch to internal dashboards (SRE/Platform), monitor query latency and storage. Week 3: enable for all Console dashboards and add automated alerts for entropy spikes.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Entropy computation may be expensive for high-cardinality tenants -> Mitigation: use approximate sketch (HyperLogLog) and pre-aggregate per-hour before entropy aggregation
Risk: Cold-start false positives due to clock skew across producers -> Mitigation: align event timestamps via ingestion pipeline watermark and tolerate 2s skew in detection window
Risk: Query regressions for dashboards -> Mitigation: Z-order + pre-warmed materialized hourly snapshot and query plan caching
